name: groundwork-docs
//overrides: WORKAROUND — pins the zod that nextra/nextra-theme-docs resolve to.
nextra-theme-docs@4.6.1's <Layout> destructures `children` out of its props and then
validates the remainder against LayoutPropsSchema, a z.strictObject whose `children` key
is declared required (`children: reactNode`, where reactNode is a bare z.custom()).
Up to zod 4.3.x a missing key backed by z.custom() parsed as valid, so the mismatch was
harmless. zod 4.4.0 changed that: a required z.custom() key now fails with
'Invalid input: expected nonoptional, received undefined -> at children', which the theme
rethrows, so EVERY prerendered page crashes (the build dies first on Next's synthetic
/_not-found route). The theme declares zod '^4.1.12', so npm otherwise resolves 4.5.x.
Bisected: 4.3.6 ok, 4.4.0 broken. Unrelated to output:'export' — reproduced without it.
REMOVE WHEN: nextra-theme-docs ships a release that either passes `children` into
safeParse or marks it optional in LayoutPropsSchema. Verify by deleting this override
plus the one below, reinstalling, and confirming `npm run build` still exits 0.
